description: PHP class defining LDAPUserCollection, which manages a collection of LDAP user data, including LDAP users, duplicate usernames, users with duplicate usernames, failed users, and counts of duplicates.

classes.name: LDAPUserCollection
classes.description: Manages LDAP user collections, including LDAP users, duplicates, and failed entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LDAP user collection with LDAP users, duplicate usernames, users of duplicate usernames, and optionally failed users.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Returns all LDAP users as an associative array.

methods.name: getDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns a list of usernames that have duplicates.

methods.name: getUsersOfDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns a mapping of usernames to their LDAPUser objects in case of duplicates.

methods.name: getDuplicateUserCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of duplicate users across all duplicate usernames.

methods.name: getFailedUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of users that failed to be processed.
